units: Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᶜ החד ק׳ ḥad (sharp) means spiced wine; Y. Ab. Zar. III, 41ᵃ top. Pesik. Baḥod., p. 102ᵇ מה ק׳ הזה וכ׳ (not טין …) as spiced wine contains wine, honey and pepper &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 10:7:4">Y. Yeb. X, 11ᵇ</cite> <he>אנא משקי ליה ק׳</he> I shall give him spiced wine to drink; <he>הא אזיל ק׳</he> the spiced wine (that was promised) is gone (forfeited).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:1:17">Y. Ber. II, 4ᵇ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 12</cite> <he>קונט׳</he>, <he>קנוט׳</he> (corr. acc.); a. e.

senses.gloss: spices to be put in wine (prob. to be read: קוֹנְדִּיטִין pl.).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:9:3">Y. Bets. I, 60ᵈ</cite> <he>מהו מישחוק ק׳ וכ׳</he> how about grinding spices for wine on the Holy Day? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:9:3">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>שחק מר ק׳ וכ׳</he> do you grind spices &c.? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 19:1:6">Y. Sabb. XIX, 16ᵈ</cite> bot.; a. e.
